Americans are told that they must absorb rocketing costs of war of choice on Iran.

This was all avoidable.

text:
D.C. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced her office is planning to target parents if their teens violate the local curfew.

The move is aimed at curbing the growing problem of "teen takeovers," which are flash mob-style gatherings involving large groups of teens.
translated_text:

此举旨在遏制日益严重的“青少年接管”问题，这是一种涉及大批青少年的快闪族式聚会。

text: A growing Ebola outbreak in Congo has now spread to Uganda, with at least 65 people dead and hundreds of suspected cases reported. Health experts warn the situation is especially dangerous because the strain involved has no approved vaccine or treatment.
